Inilauncher uses the Accessibility Service API for one feature only: double tap on the home screen to lock your phone. 

The service only sees taps inside Inilauncher and uses them only to lock the screen. It does not look at other apps or at anything you type. 

Nothing is collected, stored or shared, and nothing leaves your device. 

Tap Accept, then turn on Inilauncher in your device's Accessibility settings.
